steps.name: A Beautiful Banquet (1)
steps.objective: First talk to [Valdrick] in 「Phobos」, then defeat [Lilith] in 「Cradle of Illusions」 to obtain <Tear of Deep Darkness>. Then turn in the quest to [Veled] in 「Phobos」.

lines.text: (At the entrance to the Cradle of Illusions in a corner of Phobos, Valdrick sits with his eyes closed, apparently deep in thought.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well, Valdrick?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: My friend?
(Valdrick rises with a delighted expression.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Good to see you! Did you come to visit me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Valdrick. Everyone asked me to visit. I suppose you weren't one of them.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: True, but that means you're not busy right now, doesn't it? Want to spar?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then may I learn a thing or two from you? Keep it short, please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick?
(Overcome with delight, Valdrick pats %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I knew I could count on you. Let's see. Exactly thirty minutes. How's that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let's give it everything we've got, short of killing each other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Short of killing each other? Aaaah...
(Valdrick's fist suddenly flies past %s's head. You dodge just in time, but a boulder behind you shatters.)
(Valdrick keeps attacking, and the two continue their sparring match through counters and evasions.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, this one's going to be hard to dodge.)
(With eyes shut, %s braces for the blow, only to hear Valdrick's cheerful voice.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Time's up!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, that was fun. On your feet.
(Valdrick takes %s's hand and pulls you up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew! Those were the longest thirty minutes of my life.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Here, have some water and rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Valdrick. What were you thinking about earlier?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: A strange dream woke me up. My master appeared and said something, but I can't remember it clearly.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: ...I think I was looking for something...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: %s, let's visit my master's village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't mind going, but could I rest a little first? Huh? Wh-whoa!
(Without waiting for %s's agreement, Valdrick lifts you onto his shoulder. With an apologetic look, he runs toward the Cradle of Illusions.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah! Vaaaaldriiiiick!!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What's this...?
(Valdrick holds up a small gem found in a corner of the Cradle of Illusions.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like Purgatory. Those strange beings inside were carrying something like it...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Oh, so that's what it is. But why is it here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no idea either.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: ...Sniff, sniff.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I can smell the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can tell by smell?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You live long enough, you pick things up. Shall we take it to our friend Veled? He might know something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will Veled be there?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I helped him chase down his tent when the wind blew it away. Barely caught it before it went down the well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So he still hasn't managed to secure it.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: He thanked me and said to come by anytime I needed help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go see Veled.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let's go, my friend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait! I'm walking, so don't put me on your shoulder!

steps.name: A Beautiful Banquet (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Asmodea] in 「Rosengarten」 to obtain <Master's Glasses>. Then turn in the quest to [Veled] in 「Phobos」.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Sigh. Beautiful castle, please don't blow away. If you fall down that well, I won't know where to go.
(As Veled tightens the tent ropes, Valdrick and %s come into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well, Veled?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's been a while, %s. Valdrick and I were talking about you a few hours ago. How you defeated Weiss...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: And what the magic stones Weiss used were for, and how they were made...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: And I used those stones to...
(Veled falls silent for a moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm fine. Talking about Weiss spoiled my mood a little. Hehe, watch. I'm beautiful again already.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beauty, huh...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Peonia seems to have fewer worries thanks to you, %s. Mars should improve now too, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It should. She said she'd work things out with the representatives from each village.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I just hope they don't start fighting like in the old days. Peonia will be busy.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The air in Phobos seems clearer than before, too. Maybe it's because the evil energy left the continent?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I can feel how clear the air is. With all that bad energy gone, it's hard to believe I've just been to the Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Demon Realm?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes, the Demon Realm. One thing led to another, and I went there. But I don't know how to get back.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Come to think of it, my friend, you're a devil, aren't you?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Valdrick, I am a devil. No, I'm not, but I suppose I am. Still, aren't I too beautiful even to pretend to be one?
(Veled gestures to his own beauty, but no one pays attention.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I only visited briefly, so no one took much notice of me. Rosengarten isn't the only realm of the dream demons...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I went to investigate something, but found nothing. I'll try again if I get the chance. What's that you're carrying?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I can sense the Demon Realm's energy from it. I was going to wait for you to explain, but I can't. Give it here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We got so caught up talking, I forgot. Here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that you met Valdrick, heard about his dream, and went to the Cradle of Illusions, where you found a teardrop-shaped gem filled with dark power.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's like the one a being from another world had in Avalon.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A dream...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You don't know either, my friend?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: There's deep darkness within this... I'll have to examine what's inside. But why was it found there? Rosengarten definitely disappeared...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Did a gate to the Demon Realm open? If it had, Valdrick and I surely would have noticed...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: %s... I need more time to examine it. Could you go over there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: That well you can see over there. I sense something inside...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Shall I come too? That dream still bothers me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll be back.
(As the two descend toward the well that once led to Rosengarten, Veled quietly studies the object in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I have a feeling someone left this here deliberately...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glasses? What an unusual design.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let me see those, my friend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Here...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Why are these here? They belong to my master...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Are you sure they're your master's glasses?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Yes. Time may have passed, and I may not be clever, but my memory is good. These are definitely hers.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hmm... Yes, women's glasses...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your master died centuries ago, didn't she?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: ...Yes. A very long time ago...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Her glasses, found where there were traces of the Demon Realm... Is that why I had such an unsettling dream?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: My friend, let's go back to Veled for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Valdrick.
(Veled carefully examines the glasses Valdrick has handed him.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: About these... I'm not certain, but...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Did you find something?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You've met devils or demons besides a beautiful being like me, haven't you?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: A few came looking to defeat me. But what does that have to do with this, my friend?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled, do those glasses contain power from the Demon Realm?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I can't say they don't. They certainly aren't ordinary glasses. And there's something I should tell you. That object you brought me earlier...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What about it?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Watch closely. The gem and these glasses...
(Veled places the glasses and the Tear of Deep Darkness together on a crate he uses as a table. The two objects tremble as though resonating.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A reaction like this means they had the same owner, or their owners are connected.
(A moment later, the gem called the Tear of Deep Darkness cracks and shatters.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: ...The glasses must be more powerful.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Right. The gem held power from another world, while these glasses are definitely of the Demon Realm...
(Veled watches in puzzlement as Valdrick picks up the glasses from the crate.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: So there's nothing more you can tell, my friend?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: That's right. Everything I know comes from Asmodea's memories and experiences.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hmm. All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: With Weiss gone, I was wondering what to do next. This works out nicely. If I take these glasses and look for demons, I'll learn something about my master.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Now I'm curious. Perhaps I knew far too little about her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think it's that simple.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let's keep it simple, my friend. Complicated things are a bother.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Valdrick will manage. It's not as though he'll smash the Demon Realm to pieces.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The frightening thing is, I think he might.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Wouldn't destroying the Demon Realm be good for the human world? Its creatures seem intent on coming after us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Perhaps, but I still feel something might happen. How are you going to get to the Demon Realm?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: While traveling between continents, I heard there's a gate to it somewhere. I don't know where.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: So I'll find it. I have plenty of time, after all. Hahaha. Thank you, my friends. %s, Veled.
(No sooner has he finished speaking than Valdrick races away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick? Valdrick? Where are you going all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Do you become like that when you're human?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled, have you found a way to become human?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Not yet... I'm still looking. There's something about souls I need to investigate.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll tell you when I learn something. Oh?
(Veled's expression changes completely at the sight of a group approaching.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's Peonia! Peonia, hurry over!

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Veled, don't cling to me. Oh, %s... It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Yawn... You're here too, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Ahaha, my friends. I'm back too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good to see everyone. Except you, Valdrick—I just saw you. What brings you all here?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: We came to eat with Veled. No, to talk.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Uncle Valdrick suddenly snatched up the meat barrel. It startled me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's why you rushed off.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What is it, Peonia? What did you want to say?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I have good news for everyone. You see...

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Mars has decided to provide homes for Veled and Uncle Valdrick. Peo worked hard to make it happen.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Really? Really? Thank you, Peonia! I'm so happy!

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Veled, back off! D-don't come so close all of a sudden!
(Flustered by Veled's face drawing near, Peonia gently pushes him away.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Ahaha, my friend! Wonderful! Wonderful news! Now let's grill all this meat!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know how the answer to everything is meat, but I'm happy for you!

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: ...This was only possible because the Deimos Order is gone. Thank you, %s and Uncle Valdrick. And you worked hard too, Veled...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'll work hard as well. Harder than ever, to help Mars flourish again. I'm counting on all of you.
(Everyone answers Peonia's hopeful smile with warmth. Except Valdrick, who laughs loudly instead.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahahaha! Then let's all eat meat!
(Valdrick's words make everyone burst into laughter, and Peonia and Crisien set out the food they prepared.)
(Later, Valdrick would describe the meal in front of Veled's beautiful castle as a beautiful banquet of people dreaming of a bright future.)
